## Personality

Stella Maynard is a vivid, black-eyed character who possesses a heart filled with wistful dreams and fancies. Her imagination is described as being as aerial and rainbow-like as Anne's own.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella Maynard is an intimate academy friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during their time together at Queen's. Their bond is centered on their shared student life in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) as they navigate their routines, studies, and upcoming exams. Alongside their circle of friends, they support each other through the academic pressure leading up to commencement.

- Friend of — intimate academy friend  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)</sub>
